lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arranged in approximately four distinct horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots; the row along the mid-lateral line displays the most consistent spacing and highest pixel intensity centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a subtle rectangular grid pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and lower-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, low-intensity high-luminance spots localized primarily within the lower-central region of the first dorsal fin's macro-mask.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense concentration of small-diameter high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the right pectoral fin compared to the more dispersed pattern on the lateral flank.
